Definition: properly, to fasten up, i.e. with a bar or cord; hence, to sandal, i.e. furnish with slippers
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bar, lock, bolt; 1a) (Qal) to bar, lock, bolt; 2) to furnish with sandals, shoe; 2a) (Qal) to shoe; 2b) (Hiphil) to give sandals
